\begin{table}[ht]
\centering
\small
\caption{Budget to reach $90\%$ convergence, expressed two ways. \textbf{Top of each cell:} $B_{\mathrm{brute}}/B_{\mathrm{alg}}$, the factor less budget than the baseline (greater than one is better). \textbf{Bottom:} $B_{\mathrm{alg}}/B_{\mathrm{ceiling}}$, how many times the attainable optimum the algorithm still needs ($1.00\texttimes$ would be optimal).
